text: …　どうも　うまく　いかないわ

structure.jp: …　どうも　うまく　いかないわ
structure.en: ... somehow it just doesn't go well

patterns.name: どうも〜ない
patterns.span: どうも　うまく　いかない
patterns.explanation: どうも with a 'not' word means 'somehow just not, no matter what'. どうも　うまく　いかない = 'somehow it just doesn't go well'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end is a soft, feminine way to finish a statement and adds a little feeling. いかないわ = 'it doesn't go well'.
